document.title: Security Bulletin: NVIDIA NemoClaw and OpenShell - August 2026

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

notes.text: NVIDIA OpenShell for all platforms contains a vulnerability where a malicious gateway could cause OS command injection. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to code execution, data tampering, and information disclosure.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: code execution, data tampering, information disclosure
notes.title: Impacts

cwe.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

notes.text: NVIDIA OpenShell Sandbox for Linux contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause a path traversal bypass of L7 REST network policy. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure and data tampering.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: data tampering, information disclosure
notes.title: Impacts
